activity.notes: William of Avesnes simultaneously held Zeeland as William II from 1304 until his death in 1337. Holland, Zeeland and Hainaut remained institutionally distinct Low Countries principalities despite their dynastic union, so ATLAS preserves the Zeeland title as its own concurrent Activity.
